title: Saturating spaces for the squared-gradient nonlinearity on compact Riemannian manifolds via Nash embeddings
summary: We study the saturation property on smooth compact Riemannian manifolds without boundary. Starting from a finite-dimensional space of smooth functions, one considers successive iterations of the nonlinear map $f\mapsto|\nabla_g f|_g^2$ and convex combinations. We extend to the general setting of compact manifolds existing results on particular geometries, namely the torus, spheres and Lie groups.
